name: cavemio-revenue-chart
title: Revenue chart
description: This year as an area, last year behind it; point at a month and the header becomes the readout, switch the measure and the lines reshape.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Grey in a new shadcn project? Its default theme sets --chart-1 to --chart-5 to greys. Set five colours, light and dark, as in Theming › Chart colours (/ui/theming#charts).
- The plot is one tab stop: arrow keys, Home and End move between months, the header follows, and the month with both figures is announced politely; Escape returns to the year.
- The two lines differ by more than colour: this year is solid with a wash beneath, last year is a dashed grey line, and the legend draws both keys.
- Every month is in a visually hidden table with both years, and the totals in its caption.
- The line uses --chart-1 (your primary if the theme has no chart colours); gridlines are solid fine lines.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion the chart is simply there and changes happen in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: labels
props.description: – · Along the bottom, one per point; they thin out on narrow screens.

props.name: titles
props.description: – · Longer names for the readout, e.g. "August".

props.name: metrics
props.description: – · { id, label, current, previous?, format?, total? ("sum" or "average") }. More than one shows a switch.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: the first measure · The measure on show, by id; controlled or not.

props.name: series
props.description: ["This year", "Last year"] · The two lines’ names, in the legend and the readout.

useCases.title: SaaS and finance dashboards

useCases.title: Stripe revenue reports
useCases.description: Paid invoices by month, with last year behind them.

useCases.title: Shop dashboards
useCases.description: Switch between revenue, orders and average order value.

useCases.title: Board and investor reports
useCases.description: A year-on-year chart that answers questions when someone points at a month.

features.title: This year against last
features.description: This year is a solid line over a soft area, last year a dashed grey line behind it.

features.title: The header is the readout
features.description: Point at a month and the title, the total, the change chip and last year’s figure all roll to that month. Leaving rolls them back.

features.title: Switch the measure
features.description: Revenue, Orders or Average order: both lines morph to their new shapes while the scale and figures roll.

features.title: A year still in progress
features.description: This year’s line ends with a dot at the latest month, and the comparison uses last year’s same months.

features.title: It draws itself in
features.description: The first time the card is in view the chart is revealed from left to right.

features.title: Not colour alone
features.description: Solid and dashed lines tell the years apart, and every month is in a hidden table with both years.

states.title: arrive
states.description: In view for the first time, everything drawn is revealed from left to right (1200ms) and the total rolls up from zero.

states.title: hover
states.description: A thin line glides to the nearest month (260ms, slight overshoot) with a dot on each line. The title morphs to "<measure> in <month>", the total rolls to the month, the chip shows its change on last year and the line below morphs to last year’s figure for it. Leaving rolls it all back.

states.title: measure
states.description: With more than one measure, the pill is thrown to the choice (460ms); both lines and the area tween to their new values (640ms) while the scale labels and figures roll.

states.title: partial
states.description: When this year has fewer values than labels, its line ends with a dot at the latest month and the comparison uses last year’s same months.
